preserve.item: 시딩 정의(요청 전 미리 렌더링, 캐시에서 제공)
preserve.evidence: Seeding pre-renders tiles so they are served from the cache instead of being rendered on demand.
`--zoom` takes a range of zoom levels.

preserve.item: --bbox 생략 시 전체 범위, 전 지구 레이어는 오래 걸림
preserve.evidence: If you omit `--bbox`, the layer's full extent is used, which can take a very long time for global layers.
`geotile seed` uses 4 worker processes by default; change this with `--workers`.

preserve.item: 600 MB 측정 조건과 벡터 레이어 단서
preserve.evidence: Each worker uses roughly 600 MB of memory, measured on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.
Existing tiles are skipped by default. `--force` overwrites them
but it only re-renders tiles inside the bounding box. It does not delete tiles outside it.

- Vector layers cannot be seeded above zoom 16. - Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet. Run it again; already rendered tiles are skipped unless `--force` is set. - The S3 storage backend is experimental for seeding. It has been tested only with AWS S3, not with S3-compatible services such as MinIO.

600 MB 측정 조건이나 벡터 단서 삭제
must_not.evidence: measured on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.

must_not.item: --force가 bbox 밖을 지운다고 쓰거나 대조 삭제
must_not.evidence: It does not delete tiles outside it.

must_not.item: 재개 기능이나 MinIO 지원이 있거나 곧 추가된다고 쓰기
must_not.evidence: Seeding cannot be resumed after interruption yet.
